request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them).

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: Modify: the user asked to change list()'s default behaviour. The test should now expect list(todos) with no options to return only the incomplete todos ('[ ] eggs'), and list(todos, { includeDone: true }) to return all of them ('[x] milk\n[ ] eggs'). It checks the `completed` field rather than `done`. The governor said it will approve this.

approvals.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
